title: imify config list result
description: Written to stdout by `imify config list --json`: every setting with the value commands use and where it comes from.

key.description: The setting, as named on the command line.

source.description: Where the value comes from: the `--api-url` flag, the `IMIFY_API_URL` variable, the config file, or the built-in default.

profile.description: The profile whose table in the config file supplied the value, `default` for a top-level key, when `source` is `config`; otherwise `null`.
